pairs.subject: invariant-placement
pairs.evidence: features/profile/getProfileData.ts:53 The loader coerces a missing edge weight or prop to a definite 0 with no signal, so ally agreement, shared ballots and per-bill speech or amendment counts can publish a zero about a named MP, which profileTypes.ts itself rejects for the Rebellion fields as a statement manufactured from a data gap.

techniques.evidence: features/profile/profileMoney.ts:136 The rule that an outage must never read as no ties has a published-claim blast radius but lives in a boolean beside an always-empty ties array, checked by each consumer (MoneySection.tsx:85, ProfilePage.tsx:111). The sibling field uses the shape form (absence: ProfileAbsenceRecord | null). Latent: both current consumers guard it.

features/profile/ProfilePage.tsx:67 The comment above claims a fourth role fails to compile here, but features/profile has no @ts-expect-error or type-level negative artifact, so deleting satisfies leaves everything green. Door-level refusals are tested (rebellionProvenance.test.ts:64); the shape-level half is not.

features/profile/getProfileData.ts:122 A readiness check was removed on the authority of a value that can come from the cross-request chamberMemo (getLeaderboardData.ts), whose own comment says the data changes when da:kg-compute writes. features/profile/getProfileData.ts:642 Reader and offline writer agree only by spelling in schemaless props. prop-registry.json gates written keys, but nothing in features reads the registry and no diff checks keys read, so a misspelt read becomes a null rendered as missing data. loaders.test.ts seeds the key it expects.
